observations.source: Prior Circle transparency snapshot in ledger

reconciliation.current_window: Third-party trackers cluster around $71.2B-$71.7B for Oct 26-27; Circle's public page rounds to $71.0B for Oct 26. This is broadly consistent after rounding/timing differences.
reconciliation.historical_conflict: The prior issuer-reported $72.0B on Oct 22 differs from third-party market-cap estimates around $74.0B for Oct 22. These are not guaranteed to be the same metric, timestamp or supply universe.
reconciliation.corrected_interpretation: Do not treat the Circle-page comparison of $72B on Oct 22 to $71B on Oct 26 as a reliable $1B net-redemption estimate. A separate DefiLlama-derived series reports approximately $2.6B lower USDC supply from Oct 7 to Oct 26; that contraction is plausible but still does not reveal destination, venue allocation or XRP flow.
reconciliation.reason: Mixed source definitions and snapshot times; no harmonized daily mint/burn series, XRPL-specific USDC supply, exchange balances or linked XRP order flow.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The apparent USDC supply changes combine real contraction with differences in measurement definitions, timestamps and source coverage; a raw issuer-page delta is not a clean flow feature.
supporting: Circle page and third-party trackers broadly agree around $71B on Oct 26-27
DefiLlama-derived series reports USDC down about $2.6B from Oct 7 to Oct 26
disconfirming_or_alternative: Third-party daily series could be consistent with real net redemptions; the source mismatch does not negate the broader contraction signal.
Stablecoin supply contraction may affect crypto liquidity indirectly, but does not identify where funds went or establish XRP demand.
competing_hypotheses.test_plan: Store daily same-provider observations with exact metric definition and timestamps; reconcile issuer mint/burn and reserve reports; measure chain-specific USDC and venue balances; test any lagged XRP association out of sample.

research_pr_1195.note: These checks validate head 87003b6. This snapshot and subsequent ledger update are newer.

next_actions: Use same-provider daily USDC supply and mint/burn observations for model features; do not mix issuer circulation with market-cap estimates.
Acquire XRPL-native USDC supply/transfer and venue balance series before testing any XRP linkage.
Keep all USDC supply observations blocked from directional XRP forecasting until time-aligned, source-harmonized and validated out of sample.
Preserve the research ledger and current Barrot V3 code; no merge or main write.
